newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500 futures end strongly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500 futures end strongly higher.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures ended strongly higher and well-above psychologically key 700.00, closing near session highs.
Traders said market-on-close buy orders in the last moments of trading and buystops at 705.25 and 705.60 pushed December to a new session high of 706.10 late.
"Everybody was buying it on the rally," an S&P 500 futures trader said.
Another trader called it "a streak straight up."
December S&Ps finished up 7.50 points at 705.90.
